current.text: He plays for Detroit after leaving the Clippers. He is the projected starting power forward in place of Tobias Harris, next to Cunningham, Robinson, Thompson and Duren.
Detroit has weak depth at power forward, and Isaiah Stewart is gone.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season, which limited everyone's minutes.
He should play 30 to 31 minutes, as Tobias Harris did, up from 27 last season.
He becomes a category-league value if he plays 31 minutes.
He is fine in rounds 9 to 10 in category leagues. His ESPN rank of 99 is a bit high.
Experts agree that his upside is low. One expert calls him underrated at an ADP of 118, but another says that is too big a gap from Jarrett Allen's ADP in the 70s.
He should beat last season's rank of about 120 thanks to more stability, usage and minutes. He will not reach his prime level, and he is not a 20 and 10 player anymore.
His rebounding dip to five per game last season looks low for him. He is usually about an eight-rebound player.
Experts see him as a real-life downgrade from Tobias Harris and a worse fit for Detroit. They still expect him to play a lot.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, with no rest risks expected.

durable.text: He is an off-ball play finisher who does not create his own shot. He spaces the corners, cuts and plays a passive role.
He gives a high FG% on modest volume and a good FT%.
He hits a good percentage from three, but he takes few threes and his shooting is streaky.
He does not pass, so assists are his weakest category.
He is a weak defender, and his defensive stats have dropped.
Experts disagree on his rebounding. One calls him a modest rebounder at about five per game. Others say he has been a good offensive rebounder throughout his career.

note: At a Yahoo value of 3 USD and an average cost near 1 USD, he is an end-of-draft pick in our league. That is below the 7 USD he cost here last season. The newest call puts him in rounds 9 to 10 with low upside, and his ESPN rank of 99 looks a bit high. He has a positive FG% and rebounds with no weak category, so he fits any build as a cheap Util or F/C filler. Early in the season, check whether his minutes reach about 31 and whether his rebounds return from 5.3 toward the 7 to 8 that the projections expect.
